suggested_fix: No fix needed. The function already switches the ring to large (3K) RX buffers both when max_frame_size exceeds IGB_MAX_FRAME_BUILD_SKB and when Store Bad Packet (E1000_RCTL_SBP) is enabled. With SBP on, the hardware may DMA oversized frames, so this check stops them from overflowing a 2K buffer. Keep the SBP check whenever this code is refactored.
